vanilla.observedShape: PMC elimination on Customs while wearing specified gear including Scav vest; no exact Scav backpack pair and no successful-extraction completion contract.

scorpion.observedShape: Elimination challenge wearing Scav Vest plus baseball cap and no armor; it does not require the selected Scav backpack or make successful extraction the completion contract.

decision.review: The selected low-tier gear intentionally reuses familiar vanilla equipment, so Scav Vest overlap alone is not a defect. Reviewed vanilla and Scorpion content use the vest as part of combat challenges; Artem does not reference either exact selected TPL in indexed pinned content. No reviewed source reproduces the bounded Admiral contract requiring the exact Scav Vest plus exact Scav backpack as a non-consumed field loadout tied to successful extraction. External semantic overlap is therefore resolved, while multi-group equipment AND semantics and same-raid equipment-to-extraction coupling remain independently fail-closed.

regressionBoundary: If Expedition Loadout changes from the exact two-item non-consumed pair, gains handover/FIR/grind semantics, or loses mandatory successful extraction, this overlap decision no longer applies and must be re-reviewed.
